title: The Word Momentum
short_teaser: Momentum originally belongs to physics, but it became a way to describe progress that makes continued movement easier.
story: Momentum originally belongs to physics, but it became a way to describe progress that makes continued movement easier. Metaphors help us carry understanding from one field into another. Words shape what we notice, remember, and make possible together. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
